title: Doory – Open-Source Canva
summary: Doory is an open-source web-based graphic design tool that aims to be a free alternative to Canva, allowing users to create visual designs, presentations, and social media graphics directly in the browser without subscription fees.
problem_solved: Provides a free, self-hostable alternative to Canva for creating professional designs without recurring subscription costs.
why_valuable: Empowers designers and developers with full control over their design tools through open-source development, customization options, and privacy-friendly self-hosting capabilities.
